title: jspsych-fps-lab study config
description: One research study. Load with ?study=<file name without .json>, or in JATOS through the component input {"study": "<id>"} that npm run build:jatos sets.

content_warning.description: Plain text of the first screen. Default: the content warning in AGENTS.md.

consent_html.description: The researchers' consent text (HTML). The list of recorded data and where it goes is added below it.

instructions_html.description: Shown after consent, before the first block. Default: the game controls.

iwad.description: The game data loaded at start. Development builds play miniwad unless ?iwad= is given.

face.description: Status-bar face: "freedoom" (the IWAD's own) or a face id (M4).

url_params.description: Names of URL query parameters to store with the data (never shown on the page).

completion_url.description: Where participants go after finishing, e.g. back to a recruitment platform.

target.description: download: a JSON file in the browser only; jatos: the lab's JATOS server; datapipe: DataPipe (prepared, not implemented yet).

jatos.description: Fixed UUIDs of the JATOS study, component and batch; re-importing the study updates it in place.

time_limit.description: Seconds of game time (pauses don't count); at most 15 minutes.

prompt_html.description: Shown over the game until the participant clicks to start.

measures.description: Measure ids, or {id, params}. Default: all measures.
